watches.name: MATT BLACK GT (PRE-ORDER NOW)
watches.description: PRE-ORDERS AVAILABLE NOW! THE ALL NEW MATT BLACK GT WATCH IS NO IN PRODUCTION WITH PRE-ORDERS NOW LIVE. LIMITED FIRST RUN BATCH SO IT'S NOT ONE TO MISS OUT ON. SPECIAL PRE ORDER PRICE OF £105 FROM FUTURE RRP£129. DISPATCHED BY US MID NOVEMBER. The Matt Black GT is a modern motorsport watch inspired by the classic driver’s watches of the golden era of racing. Purposeful, understated and designed with a strong automotive character, it draws influence from vintage racing instruments, grand touring cars and the clean simplicity of analogue dashboards. The result is a distinctive racing watch that combines retro motorsport styling with a refined, everyday finish. At the heart of the design is a bold 42mm stainless steel case, giving the Matt Black GT a confident presence on the wrist while retaining the balanced proportions of a traditional driver’s watch. The deep black dial is designed for instant legibility, with crisp Arabic numerals, contrasting hands and a motorsport-inspired minute track. A practical date display adds everyday usability without taking away from the clean, uncluttered design. Subtle racing details run throughout the watch. A fine yellow ring adds a flash of colour inspired by classic competition cars, while the genuine leather strap takes cues from vintage driving gloves and performance car interiors. The yellow stitching on the strap is designed to match the yellow ring around the bezel, creating a cohesive detail that strengthens the watch’s retro motorsport character. These contrasting accents give the Matt Black GT a distinctive finishing touch and reinforce its identity as a true motorsport watch. With a 22mm lug width, the watch also offers excellent flexibility for changing straps and creating a different look. Designed for drivers, motorsport enthusiasts and anyone who appreciates automotive-inspired design, the Matt Black GT is built for more than just weekend drives. The robust 42mm stainless steel case and 10ATM / 100 metre water resistance make it suitable for everyday wear and an active lifestyle, while the reliable Japanese quartz movement delivers dependable accuracy with minimal maintenance. Whether worn behind the wheel, at a race meeting, on a weekend road trip or simply as an everyday timepiece, the Matt Black GT captures the character of a true racing watch — clean, functional and inspired by the world of classic motoring. For anyone looking for a distinctive motorsport watch with genuine retro racing influence, the Matt Black GT blends automotive heritage, practical everyday performance and timeless driver-focused design.

watches.name: Sportline, Silver Dial (COMING EARLY 2027)
watches.description: NEW MODEL RELEASE COMING EARLY 2027 HIT THE 'NOTIFY ME' BUTTON TO REGISTER YOUR INTEREST FOR IT'S PRE-ORDER RELEASE The Sportline is our interpretation of the classic driver's watch—clean, purposeful and effortlessly refined. Inspired by vintage grand touring cars, it combines timeless design with motorsport heritage, creating a watch that feels equally at home behind the wheel or in everyday life. Crafted from polished stainless steel and paired with a perforated leather rally strap, the Sportline captures the spirit of classic motoring in its purest form. The crisp silver-white dial is designed for exceptional legibility, featuring applied hour markers, a subtle grey minute track and a practical date display. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a balanced, uncluttered design that celebrates understated elegance rather than unnecessary complexity. The perforated leather rally strap pays tribute to the driving gloves and leather interiors that defined the golden era of motorsport, while the polished stainless steel case adds a modern, premium finish. Whether you're heading out for a weekend drive through winding country roads, meeting friends for coffee, or simply appreciating the craftsmanship of classic design, the Sportline is made to accompany every journey. It's a watch inspired by the romance of driving—not speed alone—but the freedom, character and timeless enjoyment that come with every mile. The Sportline watch features a casing of 42mm all stainless steel, with a water resistance of 100 metres. The Sportline runs a highly reliable Japan quartz movement with a date display at 6 o'clock. The caseback features a chequered print and lastly all models tailor a genuine leather strap.

watches.name: Esses GT Chronograph, Black Rally Strap
watches.description: Esses GT Chronograph, Black Rally Strap The Esses GT Chronograph wrist watch is inspired by GT racing—a blend of class and aggression that visually transports you to the esses of a race track. This chronograph delivers a mix of tradition and modernity, with a black steel-rimmed dial and bezel featuring a tachymetre that nods to GT cars old and new, enhanced by a bold red subdial hand that adds unmistakable race cues. Elegant on the wrist and designed for everyday wear, it sits confidently thanks to a genuine leather rally watch strap that gives the watch added comfort on the wrist. Powered by a highly reliable Japan Miyota OS10 chronograph quartz movement, the Esses GT keeps precise time and timing capabilities you can trust on and off the track. 43.5mm brushed stainless steel case with a black stainless steel bezel and tachymetre Black dial with steel-rimmed details and a red subdial hand for added racing flair Three subdials and a date window at 4 o'clock for daily and sports timing Japan Miyota OS10 chronograph quartz movement for reliable performance Water resistant up to 100m, ready for everyday adventures and weekend trips Caseback features a chequered print for a nod to GT racing heritage The Esses GT is crafted to be immediately functional whether you're clocking lap times, tracking a distance, or simply enjoying a stylish daily companion. Its robust build, legible dial, and race-inspired details make it a standout choice for fans of automotive culture who want a watch that performs as well as it looks.
